messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — dropping MPTX-7B weights into s3: s3://redwood-weights/mptx/7b/v1/weights.bin. Also pushing tokenizer mapping patch (see PR). Need quick ops/runtime/qa checks before we kick off AWQ calibration.
Oliver Tran: ack, I can grab the weights. which quant presets are we targeting? AWQ baseline then GPTQ if needed?
Maya Chen: yes AWQ first. target profiles: latency-oriented (4-bit awq) and cost-oriented (int8 gptq fallback). Acceptance criteria: <=2% top-1 accuracy drop on eval suite OR explainable quality tradeoff.
Priya Kapoor: runtime config note — set `--kv-path=compat` for this model (old kv layout). If not set we see token shift. Double-check in deploy config.
Samir Patel: quick tokenizer note: the new tokenizer has a duplicated BOS token in some checkpoints (byte-level variant). That caused prefix misalignment in a previous serving run. I patched mapping in the repo but sanity check required.
Maya Chen: thanks Sam — PR is https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/1427. The mapping change is small. Please run `scripts/validate_tokenizer.py --model mptx --sample 500` if you can.
calib-bot: automatic checks started for model=mptx, weights s3 URI validated, checksum OK. tokenizer-check queued.
Oliver Tran: ran `validate_config.py` locally, got one warning: `deprecated_attention_kernel` set to true in staging config. Recommend switching to `optimized_kernel=true`.
Stu (infra): noted. I'll update deploy config in staging. Also need approval for reserved capacity spike — AWQ calibration can burst GPUs. How long is the calibration job?
Maya Chen: calibration expected ~5 hours on a single p4d for the 10k calibration set. We can reduce to 1k sample for quick smoke (30-45m).
Raj (oncall): FYI I'll be oncall during the burn window. If autoscaling misbehaves ping me directly.
Samir Patel: did a small tokenizer smoke (500 samples) — found 0.6% tokenization diffs vs prod tokenizer, mostly around emoji sequences. Not a blocker but flagging for eval.
Priya Kapoor: runtime flagged another thing — model config missing `cache-alignment=32` in deployment yaml. Small perf hit if omitted. I'll submit a patch.
Maya Chen: added calib dataset notes in the PR: using curated 10k english/2k multilingual split. For quick signoff, we can approve 1k smoke.
Lina (prod): what's the SLA/rollback plan if AWQ rollout regresses? need a canary window and auto-fallback to int8 gptq variant.
Maya Chen: yes — canary 5% traffic 1h, fallback policy -> gptq-int8 variant in same pool. Documented in the rollout plan in the PR description.
calib-bot: tokenizer-check completed: 1 failure (emoji sequences). details: 32/500 mismatches.
Samir Patel: I'll open a tiny follow-up to map those emoji sequences to stable tokens, but for AWQ smoke it's fine.
Oliver Tran: LGTM on weights path and checksum. One infra + one runtime + one QA approve needed.
Priya Kapoor: I can approve the runtime config after I push the `cache-alignment` fix.
Stu (infra): I'll approve infra once deploy yaml updated and spike capacity scheduled.
Maya Chen: thanks — leaving the PR in review. If everyone can reply with a short ack here (infra/runtime/qa), I'll kick off the 1k AWQ smoke run tonight.
Lina (prod): ack (prod).
Priya Kapoor: ack (runtime).
Stu (infra): ack (infra) — scheduled spike 9pm PT.
Samir Patel: ack (qa) — will monitor eval and post top-line metrics in this thread.
Maya Chen: great — starting prep. will post calibration logs and eval summary here when done. :rocket:
